_comment: Per-node secret policy. Keyed by Tailscale StableNodeID (get it with `just broker-myid` on the node). smID values are Bitwarden Secrets Manager secret UUIDs in the broker's read-scoped project. This file names WHICH secrets a node may receive — it holds no secret material and is safe to commit. Copy to policy.json and fill in. Parsing is strict (unknown fields other than this top-level _comment are rejected).
